instructions: Classify the identity relationship between two Project Ledger repository observations that share a weak signal (such as name token or partial slug overlap) without a deterministic remote-URL or git-root match. Output is strictly advisory for human triage.

options.distinct_projects: Separate, unrelated codebases that merely share a generic name token, org prefix, or boilerplate template word.
options.related_distinct_siblings: Separate sibling repositories in the same ecosystem or workflow (e.g. a companion CLI, SDK, or infra repo) that must remain distinct canonical projects.
options.redundant_checkout_or_mirror: Secondary mirror, backup snapshot, worktree, or stale copy of the exact same repository on another path or host.
options.same_project_candidate: High-likelihood manifestations of the exact same canonical project across paths or hosts warranting human merge review.
